[{"insert":"Seated Dumbbell Press Progression

Back to the seated dumbbell press with reps dropping to 6 across all working sets. The dumbbell version allows each arm to work independently along slightly different paths than the barbell, which reduces the risk of shoulder impingement under heavier loads. Use your Week 3 working weights as a starting point and increase where you can. The max unbroken drop set at the end finishes the session.
"}]
